title: CB Libs
headline: CB Libs Has Been Updated!
description: A new update is now available for CB Libs.
changes: Framework, inventory, and notifications now default to auto.
Automatic notifications now use the detected framework's native notification API.
Corrected RSG inventory argument ordering and item lookup for the current API.
Replaced the removed VORP IsAdmin call with ACE and group permission checks.
Corrected VORP money functions so they return success properly.
Made the manifest load order deterministic so adapters load before the main bridge.
Custom framework and inventory handlers are now enabled by selecting custom in the shared config, with no separate enabled setting.
